subject.title: fix(agents): repair orphaned tool_use pairs on compaction prune path

question: Should compaction adopt the same aborted assistant tool-call drop policy already used by prompt-send replay, or should this branch be reworked to synthesize or preserve interrupted tool-call context?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and source-supported, but the final behavior decides how much interrupted session context compaction is allowed to discard.

options.title: Accept drop-policy parity
options.body: Merge this approach so aborted tool-call turns are removed before compaction summarization, matching the existing prompt-send sanitizer and preventing strict-provider rejection.

options.title: Require synthetic recovery
options.body: Ask for a rework that keeps an explicit interrupted-tool result or other model-visible marker instead of dropping the aborted turn.

options.title: Pause the branch
options.body: Leave the PR unmerged if maintainers want a broader transcript recovery design before changing compaction behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept drop-policy parity
recommendation.body: Merge this approach so aborted tool-call turns are removed before compaction summarization, matching the existing prompt-send sanitizer and preventing strict-provider rejection.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent session-transcript-repair history makes this the closest owner for the aborted-turn repair policy.
